sources.pin: DuckDB issue #25164; issue content as captured 2026-10-06
sources.locator: Issue body and timeline in captured page: parallel CSV scan silently duplicates valid rows for CRCRLF at buffer boundaries; source reports parallel/sequential counts, buffer-size scaling, affected versions 1.4.4, 1.5.2 and 1.5.5, and a separate possible trailing-LF symptom. Timeline links #25232 and later main-branch follow-up commit 50eb6b6.

sources.pin: DuckDB PR #25232; merge commit 59ae0c6fb3f29369cfd0df124c76e9232181ef86; base branch v2.0-cyanoptera

sources.locator: ProcessOverBufferValue(), around lines 1488-1492 in this captured revision: early return after the CARRY_ON newline loop when no over-buffer value remains, newline bytes were consumed, previous scanner already counted the row, and first consumed byte was CR.

sources.locator: Complete regression fixture: creates fixed-width CRCRLF rows so row 39's first CR is byte 1023 of a 1024-byte buffer; checks 60 rows, id 39/id 40 once, parallel vs sequential, plus a mid-buffer case.
sources.applicability_and_limits: The test source demonstrates intended regression coverage and expected assertions. Candidate did not run DuckDB or this test.

sources.locator: ProcessOverBufferValue(), around lines 1373-1447. The captured release code consumes the carried newline then falls through to the second-buffer loop; it does not contain the added conditional present at S04.

sources.pin: DuckDB documentation displayed version 1.5 current at capture; mutable route captured 2026-10-06
sources.locator: CSV Auto Detection article: CSV is non-self-describing; dialect, header and column types are inferred. Use manual schema/contracts to make inference assumptions reviewable.
sources.applicability_and_limits: Official engine documentation, current-version route is mutable. It documents inference behavior, not proof that sampled inference establishes full-file properties.

sources.pin: DuckDB documentation displayed version 1.5 current at capture; mutable route captured 2026-10-06
sources.locator: Combining Schemas article: multiple files may differ; default unification is by position and union_by_name opts into name-based combination.
sources.applicability_and_limits: Official implementation documentation. It motivates explicit schema-evolution policy; it does not choose the product's contract semantics.

sources.pin: DuckDB documentation displayed version 1.5 current at capture; mutable route captured 2026-10-06
sources.locator: Reading Faulty CSV Files article intro: detailed errors, skipping faulty lines, and storing faulty lines for a cleaning step are supported engine behaviors.
sources.applicability_and_limits: Engine options make silent skip behavior a product-policy hazard. The proposal selects strict-by-default handling and does not infer that all malformed-input modes preserve source records.

sources.pin: DuckDB documentation displayed version 1.5 current at capture; mutable route captured 2026-10-06
sources.locator: Environment/performance guidance gives a memory-per-thread rule of thumb; relevant to limiting concurrent threads and budgeting a 16 GB workstation.
sources.applicability_and_limits: Guidance is not a workload benchmark or guarantee. A 5 GB input on the brief's workstation remains a target for measurement.

sources.locator: Notebook structure and schema: code cells have source, outputs and execution_count (integer or null); outputs represent execution messages; metadata is optional and may be ignored by tools.
sources.applicability_and_limits: Versioned format specification; interoperability does not provide a runtime, dependency lock, execution order history, or provenance guarantee.

sources.pin: Mutable stable documentation reported nbclient 0.11 at capture on 2026-10-06
sources.locator: NotebookClient execution/save flow, fresh kernel configuration, cell processing and error policy; default stops at first error, while allow_errors changes behavior; partially executed notebooks can be saved.
sources.applicability_and_limits: Useful implementation mechanism, but stable URL is mutable. Pin and verify exact compatible nbclient version in a built environment before product use.

sources.pin: Documentation reports jupyter_client 8.10.0 and Jupyter messaging spec 5.5 at capture
sources.locator: Message parent_header associates replies/output with their request; session identifiers identify a kernel session and change after restart.
sources.applicability_and_limits: Protocol mechanism, not a proof that application code has correctly persisted every event. Use request/session/cell IDs in an application journal and test restart races.
